description.en: The instance ID. You can obtain it by calling the ListInstances interface.
The ID of the object. You can call the ListModelFeatures or ListFeatureViews operation to obtain the ID.

description.zh:
任务对象类型。

● ModelFeature-模型特征。

● FeatureView-特征视图。
description.en:
The type of the object.

● `ModelFeature`: a model feature.

● `FeatureView`: a feature view.

description.zh: 页码，起始值为1，默认值为1。
description.en: The page number. Pages start from page 1. Default value: 1.
The number of entries per page. Default value: 10.
The ID of the project. You can call the ListProjects operation to obtain the ID.

description.zh:
状态。

● Initializing-初始化中。

● Running-运行中。

● Success-成功。

● Failure-失败。
description.en:
The task status.

● `Initializing`: The task is being initialized.

● `Running`: The task is running.

● `Success`: The task is successful.

● `Failure`: The task fails.
The task IDs by which to filter tasks.

description.zh:
任务类型过滤。

● ExportTrainingSet-导出训练样本表。
description.en: The task type by which to filter tasks.
